aboutUs.heroTagline: Bridge the gap between digital planning and physical action.

origin.title: The Origin
origin.paragraph1: Lua didn't start in a boardroom; it began as a 24-hour sprint during a college hackathon. Built by Computer Engineering student Lefika Moalosi, the original prototype was called "Campus Flow." The core problem it aimed to solve was simple: it is too easy to write down an ambitious schedule but stay stagnant in a room all day. The app was designed to force movement, requiring users (particularly students) to physically walk to their classes, meals, and social events to check them off.
origin.paragraph2: The project didn't take home the hackathon prize, but the central mechanic was too effective to leave behind. At the heart of the app was a little digital companion named Lua. Because users connected so strongly with keeping the avatar alive, Lefika kept developing the app, eventually renaming the entire project to "Lua." Today, it has evolved from a campus-only tool into a broader experiential project for anyone who wants to bridge the gap between digital planning and physical action.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.intro: Most habit trackers let you check a box from your bed. Lua requires you to earn it. By tying your daily goals to real geographic coordinates, the app verifies your follow-through using live GPS.

plan.title: Plan Your Day
plan.body: Search and schedule real-world destinations, whether that is a lecture hall, a gym, or a coffee shop.

prove.title: Prove You Were There
prove.body: When you walk within 25 meters of your destination, the app automatically detects your arrival and marks the goal complete.

consequences.title: Actions Have Consequences
consequences.body: Complete your goals, and your companion sprite, Lua, gains health while you earn XP. Miss your marks, and Lua's health drops at midnight. It is a game where your physical momentum is the controller.

helpCenter.title: Help Center & FAQ
helpCenter.welcome: Welcome to the Help Center! If you are having trouble keeping your daily streak or navigating the map, you can find answers to our most common questions below.

faqs.q: Why did my avatar's health drop?
faqs.a: Lua's health is directly tied to your real-world follow-through. If you have pending goals on your schedule that you do not physically complete by midnight, Lua's health will deplete the following day (up to 25% depending on how many goals you missed). To heal Lua, simply get back on track and complete your scheduled goals!

faqs.q: How do I earn XP and level up?
faqs.a:
You earn Experience Points (XP) by staying active and sticking to your schedule. You can earn XP in three ways:

Completing Goals: +50 XP per arrived destination

Walking Distance: +30 XP per mile

Study Hours: +40 XP per hour

faqs.q: I am at my destination, but the goal won't mark as complete. Why?
faqs.a:
Lua needs to verify you are within a 25-meter radius of your scheduled destination. If it is not updating automatically:

Check Permissions: Ensure your device's Location Permissions are enabled and set to "Precise Location."

Signal Interference: GPS signals can be blocked by thick walls or large buildings. Try stepping outside or near a window for a few seconds to let your location update.

Check the Pin: Open the live map to ensure your destination pin is in the correct spot.

faqs.q: Why isn't my walking distance accumulating on the stats page?
faqs.a: Lua uses a custom location tracker designed to filter out "GPS jitter" (when your phone thinks you are drifting while sitting still) and vehicular travel. Distance only accumulates when your movement matches a natural, real-world walking pace.

faqs.q: How does the Navigation mode work?
faqs.a: If you need help finding your goal, long-press on the map to set a destination pin. Lua will switch to a high-accuracy GPS mode, providing you with your walking ETA, bearing, and distance to the target.

faqs.q: Will I lose my progress if I delete the app or get a new phone?
faqs.a: No! Your progress is safely backed up to the cloud. As long as you sign back into your account, your profile, schedule, XP, and Lua's health will automatically sync right back to your device.
As you earn XP and level up by completing your daily goals, your progress is updated live on the community leaderboard. Keep hitting your physical destinations to climb the ranks!

faqs.q: Can I change the app's language?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Lua supports 10 different languages. You can switch your preferred language at any time by navigating to the Profile tab.

faqs.q: How do I manage my notifications?
faqs.a: You can toggle notifications on or off within the Profile tab. To adjust deeper system permissions (like background location or camera access), tap App Settings on your profile, which will open your phone's native settings menu.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: The Lua Development Team ("we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy and is strongly committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines the types of information we collect, how it is processed, stored, and shared, and the rights you have regarding your data when you use the Lua mobile application (the "App" or "Service").

Because Lua utilizes cloud-backed infrastructure to provide features like seamless cross-device synchronization, secure user authentication, and interactive leaderboards, we process and store certain data on secure external servers. Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. By creating an account or using the App, you consent to the data practices described in this document.
If you do not agree with our policies and practices, your choice is to not use the Lua application.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body:
To provide our core location-based habit-tracking mechanics and maintain an engaging user experience, we collect several categories of information.

A. Information You Provide to Us
When you register for an account and use the App, you voluntarily provide the following personal data:

Account Credentials: To create an account, you must provide a valid email address and a secure password. This authentication process is securely managed by our third-party backend providers.

Profile Information: You may choose a public display name, a unique user handle, and a profile photograph or avatar.

Scheduling and Goals: You provide details about your daily routines, including the titles of your goals, scheduled times, category tags (e.g., Academic, Meal, Social), and the specific geographic coordinates (Destinations) you intend to visit.

B. Information Collected Automatically
To function as a movement-verifying application, Lua requires specific permissions to automatically collect necessary device data:

Precise Location Data (GPS): With your explicit permission, we collect highly precise geographic location data (GPS coordinates) from your device, both in the foreground and the background. This is strictly required to render your position on the in-app map, calculate walking distance, and verify when you have successfully entered the required completion radius of a scheduled Destination.

Movement and Telemetry Data: We collect movement speed and trajectory data to filter out GPS anomalies (jitter) and to ensure the integrity of the game's economy (preventing location spoofing or traveling via vehicles when walking is expected).

Device and Usage Information: Our infrastructure automatically logs standard diagnostic data, including your mobile operating system version, device model, unique device identifiers, IP address, and crash reports. This data is used solely to optimize the App, troubleshoot errors, and fix software bugs.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body:
We process your personal information for the following specific purposes:

Providing the Core Service: To authenticate your account, synchronize your schedule across devices, render the interactive map, and manage the underlying game mechanics (including updating your Lua avatar's health, Experience Points (XP), and daily streaks).

Location Verification: To continuously compare your real-time GPS coordinates against your scheduled Destinations to trigger automatic goal completions.

Social Features and Leaderboards: To populate competitive and social elements of the App. If you participate in leaderboards, your display name, handle, avatar, and total XP/level may be visible to other users.

Security and Anti-Cheat: To monitor for suspicious activity, such as GPS spoofing, automated scripts, or other violations of our Terms and Conditions, ensuring a fair experience for all users.

Communication: To send you essential administrative emails (e.g., password resets, security alerts) and, with your permission, local push notifications reminding you of impending goals or daily penalties.

Service Improvement: To analyze anonymized usage trends, debug crash reports, and improve the overall stability and user interface of the App.

sections.title: 3. How We Share and Disclose Your Information
sections.body:
We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information or continuous location history to third-party data brokers or advertisers. We only share your data in the following highly specific circumstances:

A. Third-Party Service Providers
We employ trusted third-party companies to facilitate our Service. These providers have access to your data only to perform specific tasks on our behalf and are legally obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose:

Backend and Database Infrastructure: We utilize secure third-party cloud infrastructure providers to host our backend services. Your account credentials, profile data, encrypted passwords, and scheduling data are securely stored within these managed cloud environments.

Mapping and Geocoding APIs: To provide map rendering and location search functionality, the App communicates with third-party mapping and geocoding API partners. When you search for a Destination, the text query and your IP address may be processed by these external services to return the correct geographic coordinates.

Development Frameworks: Our mobile development frameworks may capture anonymized crash reports to help us identify and resolve critical software failures.

B. Other Users (Public Profile Data)
If you choose to engage with the public elements of the App, such as the Leaderboard, certain non-sensitive data—specifically your chosen display name, handle, profile picture, current level, and accumulated XP—will be visible to other registered users of the App. Your specific scheduled Destinations and real-time location are never publicly broadcast to other users.

C. Legal Requirements and Law Enforcement
We may disclose your information in the good faith belief that such action is legally necessary to:

Comply with a valid legal obligation, court order, or subpoena.

Protect and defend the rights, property, or intellectual property of the Lua Development Team.

Investigate or prevent potential technical fraud, GPS spoofing, or violations of our Terms and Conditions.

Protect the personal safety of Users of the Service or the public.

sections.title: 4. Data Storage, Security, and Retention
sections.body:
A. Cloud Security
Your data is transmitted securely over encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS). We employ industry-standard encryption and strict database-level access policies (such as Row Level Security equivalent measures) to ensure that you can only access, modify, or delete your own personal schedule and private data.

B. Data Retention
We retain your personal data only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. As long as your account remains active, we will retain your profile, stats, and historical schedule data to provide you with accurate long-term statistics.

C. Security Limitations
While we strive to use commercially acceptable, modern backend security practices to protect your information, no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic cloud storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee its absolute security against highly sophisticated cyber-attacks.

sections.title: 5. Your Data Privacy Rights
sections.body:
You maintain complete control over your personal data and have the following rights regarding its use:

Access and Rectification: You can review and update your profile information, handle, and avatar directly within the "Profile" tab of the App at any time.

Right to Deletion: You have the right to request the complete erasure of your account and all associated cloud data. You may execute this directly through the App settings or by contacting us via email. Please note that simply uninstalling the App from your device does not automatically delete your cloud-hosted account data.

Revocation of Location Permissions: You can revoke the App's access to your GPS location at any time through your device's operating system settings. However, doing so will immediately disable the App's core functionality, preventing you from completing goals or verifying arrivals.

sections.title: 6. Children's Privacy (COPPA Compliance)
sections.body:
Lua is strictly not intended for use by anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly solicit, collect, or store personally identifiable information from children under 13.

If you are a parent or legal guardian and you are aware that your child has created an account and provided us with personal data without your consent, please contact us immediately. If we become aware that we have collected information from anyone under the age of 13, we will take immediate steps to terminate the account and permanently remove that information from our servers.

sections.title: 7. Links to Other Websites and Services
sections.body: Our Service may contain links to other websites or services that are not operated by us (such as our Terms and Conditions hosted externally, or Help Center resources). If you click on a third-party link, you will be directed to that third party's site. We strongly advise you to review the Privacy Policy of every site you visit. We have no control over and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies, or practices of any third-party sites or services.

sections.title: 8. Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.body:
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our technology stack, legal obligations, or business practices. We will notify you of any material changes by updating the "Effective Date" at the top of this document. Depending on the nature of the changes, we may also provide a prominent in-app notification or require you to affirmatively accept the updated Privacy Policy upon your next login.

Your continued use of the App following the posting of any changes confirms your acceptance of the revised Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 9. Contact Information
sections.body:
We welcome your questions, feedback, and concerns regarding your privacy and how your data is handled. For any legal or data-related inquiries, to request account deletion, or for general support, please contact the Lua Development Team at:

Email: moaloslt@mail.uc.edu
